supporting_news.title: India's benchmark bond breaks 4-day falling streak as value investors return
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds have rebounded following a significant rise in yields, drawing investors back into the market. The benchmark bond yield has risen due to a central bank policy rate hike and liquidity measures. The rupee has appreciated against the dollar after the central bank implemented new measures to support the currency. Meanwhile, traders are anticipating US inflation data, which could influence Federal Reserve decisions.

supporting_news.title: Global Market: BoE's Megan Greene says UK interest rates may not be restrictive enough
supporting_news.summary: Bank of England policymaker Megan Greene said the IMF’s upward revision to the UK’s economic growth forecast supports her view that monetary policy remains insufficiently restrictive. She warned that delaying interest rate hikes could prolong inflationary pressures, highlighting divisions among policymakers over balancing inflation control against economic growth and borrowing costs.

supporting_news.title: RBI to continue efforts to curb rupee volatility; external factors driving currency fall: FM
supporting_news.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman mentioned the Reserve Bank of India’s ongoing efforts to stabilize the rupee's value. She noted that the rupee has significantly depreciated due to global uncertainties, despite India's strong economic fundamentals. Sitharaman highlighted recent measures by the RBI that helped the rupee appreciate temporarily in value. She also acknowledged the healthy debate around tax rationalization in the securities market.

supporting_news.title: Rupee outpaces Asian peers on fresh FX curbs, RBI intervention
supporting_news.summary: The Indian rupee has strengthened against the dollar, thanks to recent initiatives by the Reserve Bank of India designed to curb dollar demand and stabilize the foreign exchange market. Experts suggest that these regulatory changes may bolster the rupee's short-term resilience. Moreover, oil prices are trending downwards as new supplies from Russia potentially enter the market. Central bank actions have generally fostered support for the Indian currency.
